# WPS 000-099 System

Every violation in the System group of wemake-python-styleguide 1.8.1, from its [docs](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/system.html).
Disabled ones are struck through.

| Code | Violation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WPS000 | [InternalErrorViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/system.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.system.InternalErrorViolation) | Happens when we get unhandled exception during the linting process. |
